title: Fix MineWoodDecompose over-mining — mine single log variant
description:
**Source:** Internal audit Sprint 60 (2026-07-11) — MSA-PLAN-008

`MineWoodDecompose` in `HtnTaskLibrary.cs` (~line 830) mines BOTH `minecraft:oak_log` AND `minecraft:birch_log` at the full requested count. Same over-mining pattern as MSA-PLAN-001, for the legacy wood decomposition path.

**Recommendation:** Mine only one variant unless the first fails.
